`final class GlStateSnapshot`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.snapshot` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlStateSnapshot.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/snapshot/GlStateSnapshot.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

Reads the state of an OpenGL context that the state guard must preserve, by name.

## Description

It ships in the `snapshot` jar of base-opengl and in the dev and demo jars of the backends; the published `joid-base-opengl` jar does not hold it.

## Method details

<a id="GlStateSnapshot-method-read"></a>

### read

`Map<String,String> read(IGlBinding binding, GlCapabilities capabilities, MaterialReader materialReader)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the state of the current context, read through the binding: capabilities, bindings, blending, depth, stencil, pixel storage, viewport, scissor, the first four texture units and the vertex attributes, and the fixed-function state of a compatibility context, whose materials come from the reader.
It leaves the active texture unit as it found it.
